about.text: A Kazakh pressed curd, made in spring and dried until hard, in white and red versions; the red kind is said to be curdled with rennet. Kyrgyz sources list a sour-milk curd slow-cooked for hours under the same name.

sources.text: The white and red methods and the spring making from the Kazakh articles, and the slow-cooked curd from the Central Asian atlas.
